entries.sourceHa: Yaya za ka haɗa duk waɗannan tambayoyi zuwa jerin dubawa guda kafin ka karɓi iƙirari?
entries.reviewedAjami: یَیَ زَ کَ هَطَ دُکْ وَطَࢽَّࢽْ تَمْبَیُیِ زُوَ جٜرِࢽْ دُبَوَا غُدَا کَࢻِࢽْ کَ کَرْݑِ إِࢼِرَرِ?
entries.note: Approved exactly as drafted from the ratified-lexicon composer output, including the trailing Latin U+003F as drafted.

entries.sourceHa: Idan ba ka da cikakken tabbaci, wane mataki zai iya rage haɗari yayin da kake neman ƙarin bayani?
entries.reviewedAjami: إِدَࢽْ بَ کَ دَ ثِکَکّٜࢽْ تَبَّثِ, وَاࢽٜىٰ مَتَاکِى زَیْ إِیَ رَغٜ هَطَرِى یَیِࢽْ دَ کَکٜىٰ ࢽٜمَࢽْ ࢼَرِࢽْ بَیَࢽِى?
entries.note: Approved exactly as drafted from the ratified-lexicon composer output.

entries.sourceHa: Idan kana son wani sakamako ya faru, wace hanya za ta taimaka maka kada son naka ya rinjayi dubawarka?
entries.note: Deferred 2026-09-14. Cannot compose: rinjayi and dubawarka are not in the ratified lexicon. A hand-supplied Ajami string was offered but used standard Arabic letterforms (U+0646 noon, U+0643 kaf, U+0641 feh, U+064A yeh, U+064C dammatan) where the ratified lexicon uses Hausa Ajami forms (U+08BD, U+06A9, U+08BB, U+06CC, U+064F); Muhammad confirmed this was a keyboard artifact, not an orthography decision. Blocked pending lexicon ratification of the two missing words.

entries.sourceHa: Bayan ka kware wajen rubutu, mataki na gaba shi ne gane harajin VAT da yadda ake ware shi a rasit.
entries.note: Deferred 2026-09-14. Cannot compose: kware is not in the ratified lexicon, and VAT is an English loanword excluded at word level (precedent: chat/stock/form/Mobile/Money). A hand-supplied string was offered but carried the same standard-Arabic keyboard artifact as CT06 (14 occurrences of U+0646/U+0643/U+064A) plus U+06AF gaf where the lexicon uses U+063A ghain, and U+06A4 veh as a first-of-its-kind manual transliteration of an English acronym. Deferred by Muhammad on the same grounds as CT06; the veh/loanword transliteration question is unresolved and needs its own decision.

entries.sourceHa: Idan mutane sun ba da bayanai daban don zaɓi guda, shin suna kallon doka, sakamako, ko halin mutum?
entries.note: Deferred 2026-09-14. Review surfaced a LEXICON defect, not a prose issue: Muhammad corrected the ratified spelling of doka (ratified by him 2026-08-03, status human_reviewed). Proposed respelling uses correct Hausa Ajami letterforms (U+06A9 keheh, no keyboard artifact). The correction affects 10 content.json strings and 1 lexicon entry, so it must be applied by re-ratifying the lexicon entry and regenerating, NOT by a single-sentence prose override, which would leave the same word spelled two ways. FL04 re-enters review after doka is re-ratified. See tasks/2026-09-14-doka-reratification-note.md.

entries.sourceHa: Me za ka yi idan ka'ida biyu da ka yarda da su suna neman ka yi abubuwa mabambanta a lokaci guda?
entries.note: Deferred 2026-09-14. Review surfaced a BOKO SOURCE-TEXT defect, upstream of both the prose packet and the lexicon: Muhammad ruled the source word should be the hooked-k form (ƙa/qa-ida), not ka-ida. FL05 gapTeaser.ha is the only occurrence in content.json. Correcting it changes this entry sourceHa and sourceHash, so the packet entry must be regenerated after the source fix. Also surfaced: the merged lexicon carries BOTH ka-ida (U+06A9 keheh) and ƙa-ida (U+08BC) as separately ratified entries (both Muhammad, 2026-08-03), and apostrophe rendering is inconsistent within the ƙ forms (ƙa-ida uses U+0623 alef-hamza, ƙa-idar uses U+0639 ain). See tasks/2026-09-14-qaida-source-and-doublet-note.md.
